value.hook: open when a [pij role queue] wake names a reviewer/security instance
value.title: Role-queue wake with a live last holder: the reviewer released after round 1

sections.name: body
sections.value: A role-queue wake for reviewer/<pr> or security/<pr> whose last holder is still alive usually means the reviewer released its own per-PR holding after round 1, thinking its review was done. Round 2 then queues with no holder (seen 2026-11-20: semantic-hornet released reviewer/279 after its round-1 BLOCK, and pm-001's round-2 request queued). Check with pij-rs --json state <last holder>: if it's alive, tell the requester's PM to reassign the same seat (pij directory assign <role>/<pr> <seat> --why ... --project pij-fleet), which delivers the queue. Don't revive or assign it yourself. pm-001 now tells reviewers in packets to keep the holding until the PR merges. If the last holder is dead and was a throwaway child of a coder (e.g. falcon's *-proof roles), it is usually a deliberate live proof: leave it alone.
